_about: Layout values for machen, in points unless noted. build.sh turns this file into Sources/machen/Layout.generated.swift; rebuild to apply changes. Keys starting with _ are comments.

list._about: The scrolling list of events and tasks

rowPadding._about: Above and below each event/task row

lineGap._about: Between a row's lines: title, time, place, notes, due date

lineSpacing._about: Extra leading when a title wraps

row._shares: Shares multiply the Spacing preset's row padding. openParentBottomShare: below a task whose subtasks are showing.

bar._about: Colour bar at the left of events and tasks

disclosure._about: Count and arrow, as in 'Work 5 ›' and '2 ▾'

text._about: Font sizes at Medium. Settings → Display → Small … Extra Large multiply them by the factors below, rounded to whole points.
